Prototype 0 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (96%), with EOG (3%) and EMG (1%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated β_h (+0.9 dB, sensitivity=9.1) and elevated σ_h (+7.8 dB, sensitivity=4.5).
The β_h activity is present in 10% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 24% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is coherent with N2 physiology: σ elevated, σ relevant, EOG quiescent — all confirmed. Note: model primarily uses β_h, atypical for N2.
